test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

I __didn't wanted__ her to go out with her friends.
solution:
The correct answer is **didn't want.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence is didn't want.
 
• The above sentence is in Simple past tense.
 
• Thus the correct option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence didn't want.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simple Past Negative sentence rule**- There is a formula that works for both regular and irregular verbs to make simple past tense negative (except for the verb to be). The equation is **[did not + verb's root form].**
 
• Instead of **did not**, you can also use the contraction** didn't**.
 
 
• Example- Wolfgang didn't exaggerate his hula hoop prowess much.
